twitter_description: Han Li plays the social game in Heavenly Capital Street – polite, vague, and never revealing a single card. Real battles aren’t always fought with spells.

lore_anchors.definition: A recognized threshold state for a Foundation Establishment cultivator whose qi is so condensed it nearly forms a golden core, but has not yet completed the breakthrough; a sign of imminent Core Formation readiness.
A rare, yin-aligned liquid with a bone-chilling aura; used as a catalyst to temper the cultivator's internal yang fire during Core Formation.
A rare, yang-aligned liquid that radiates intense heat; used to fuel the elemental crucible during the Core Formation breakthrough, paired with Snow Spirit Water.
A bloc of six allied but rivalrous shops in Heavenly Capital Street, each specializing in a different trade (beast materials, magic tools, elixirs, etc.), forcing customers to visit all six.
An airborne pavilion floating above the central plaza of Heavenly Capital Street; its doors are currently shut, suggesting it only opens for high-level transactions or major events.

cultural_notes_faq.a: It is an informal threshold state for a Foundation Establishment cultivator who has reached peak qi density but has not yet formed a true golden core; it signals readiness for the Core Formation attempt, not a distinct cultivation stage.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Han Li visit the White Water Tower first?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He chose it simply because it was the nearest hall, using it as a test case to confirm his theory that each shop specializes in a different product category (magic tools) before deciding where to actually buy alchemical materials.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Are Snow Spirit Water and Heavenfire Liquid rare?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They are not as rare as thousand-year spiritual herbs, but they are still precious consumables rarely found on the open market; obtaining both requires significant wealth and a well-connected merchant.
